text_block_list.name: Local Radio Show
text_block_list.text:
"Hello to everyone around the world!
It's finally that time of year again for the ultimate festival of Umamusume racing—the Breeders' Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Local Radio Show
text_block_list.text:
"‘Who will claim the American Dream?
Which country will seize the lion's share of that glory?’"

text_block_list.name: Local Radio Show
text_block_list.text:
"This weekend, young and old alike will be glued to the BC!
Don't miss... this ultimate festival!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
How is everyone feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry. Everyone is the very picture of health.
That is precisely why we're accompanying them.
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we head to the racecourse soon?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
To the stage of our decisive battle—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeees♡ Today is finally the main event, the BC!
The racetrack is packed with spectators~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to return
all the "love" I received from everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"That takes care of recording the opening footage!
It's a video for the celebration stream, after all.
Let's do our best so we can play this with a smile!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Just got to the racetrack now.
Breakfast? Had it, totally fine, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, Mom, it's still early morning over there, right?
There's still time before my race, so don't push yourself."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Then, I'll tell you the
details after I win!
(So, let's talk specifics after I take first place♪)"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Now if I just win, they'll see my real value too.
Then I'll have connections with the higher-ups at the BC...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: This is the absolute best timing to raise our profile, so we've gotta make our opening move right here~☆

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, the articles in the Japanese racing magazines
convey an unprecedented amount of expectation...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I am convinced of the victory of the saint who once smiled and told this reporter, 'I will surpass the impossible'"...?
Could this be... from back then?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the culmination of these past two and a half years takes shape.
Listening to the roar of the crowd, my thoughts drift back to distant memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fascinated by the GⅠ spectacle I first saw on broadcast,
I yearned for its overwhelming grandeur.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Witnessing the solitary challenge taken on by Casino Drive and the predecessors inspired a longing to take on the world someday.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Together with me—
Let's seize the American Dream!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: At the Breeders' Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I feel like that was fate. A path leading toward this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "The time has finally come. Within your running... dwells that which I once passed on to you. You can do it, I know you can."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight. Once I take the lead, I don't care who it is,
I'm not letting anyone run ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I gotta show 'em the moment I become number one in the world.
And I ain't runnin' in no way that'll let 'em look down on me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna leave 'em all in the dust, so keep your eyes glued on me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: There are people waiting for me to reach "that place" today—to overcome the impossible and seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to shine the light of hope as a saint.
My entire journey until now has been for this day.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"...From the very start, you were certain that your chosen path would 'reach' it.
The power of belief is stronger than anything else."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
And people believed in that devotion, in those eyes.
You are, without a shadow of a doubt, a "Saint."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't deliver love to the whole world all by myself.
But Maru-chan is here with me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with Maru-chan, who has run with me
up to now and will keep running with me, I can do anything.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "I—I will win. I'll definitely win!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"The feelings I vowed back then are the real deal.
That's why—I'll make our dream come true together with Love-chan!"
choice_data_list: If it's you all, I'm sure you can make it come true.
If it's you all, I'm sure you can make it come true

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As you are now, you have nothing to fear.
Keep your eyes forward... and victory will surely be right in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Umatter is really buzzing.
"Bring home Japan's long-cherished victory!" they're saying.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: —Well, of course, we're not aiming for just a single win♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Your drive and innovative ideas literally
transformed the team. ...You have my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ There's nothing more boring
than rigid, negative common sense.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That's why it just clicked for me.
That presentation by Casino-san.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the BC that no one could win"
has the absolute highest value, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And if what's at stake is becoming the best in the world,
we can overturn the whole world's common sense!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I just want to expand my horizons.
Turning the "impossible" into the "possible"
makes the world so much more fun! Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You have the mindset of an entrepreneur.
It's that exact mindset that will change the era.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well then—shall we go?
To overturn the racing world's common sense...!
choice_data_list: Let's all go out there and win together!

text_block_list.name: Everyone on the Team
text_block_list.text: "Oohhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering the hopes and dreams of all Japan,
the grand stage of "DREAMS" begins now—
